page_title: LEC 1-0 PIS | Lecce v Pisa 12/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.

90+4' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) receives a yellow card.
85' Isak Vural (Pisa) leaps high deep inside the box to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick and attempts to score with a header. His effort is not accurate at all and goes well over the bar.
85' That's a clear yellow card. Tete Morente (Lecce) goes into the book.
81' Alberto Gilardino has decided to make a change. Louis Buffon (Pisa) replaces Antonio Caracciolo.
77' Corner kicks – 12:1.
76' Lorran (Pisa) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
76' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Tete Morente (Lecce), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
74' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris comes off the pitch to be replaced by Lorran (Pisa).
74' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tete Morente (Lecce) replacing Riccardo Sottil.
74' A substitution has been made. Corrie Ndaba goes off and Antonino Gallo (Lecce) comes on.
72' 1 - 0 Nikola Stulic (Lecce) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
71' Lecce fail to score from a corner as Adrian Semper (Pisa) leaps to collect the ball.
70' Now Lecce have a corner.

70' Lameck Banda (Lecce) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the bottom left corner, but Adrian Semper made a superb athletic save to deny him. Lecce force a corner. They send men into the box.
69' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) is about to take a corner kick.
67' Here is a change. Francesco Camarda is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Nikola Stulic (Lecce).
66' We are about to witness a subsitution. Lameck Banda (Lecce) for Santiago Pierotti.
66' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) fails to score from close range. He picks up a rebound, but sends it wide of the target! The ball goes out of play and Pisa will have a goal kick.
64' Samuele Angori (Pisa) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
62' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul.
60' Alberto Gilardino decides to make a substitution. Stefano Moreo will be replaced by Matteo Tramoni (Pisa).
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Samuele Angori (Pisa) is coming onto the pitch as Ebenezer Akinsanmiro cannot continue after picking up an injury.
59' That was close. Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
57' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
52' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
52' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Francesco Camarda. Lecce get a corner.
51' The free kick from long range, taken by Pisa, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
50' Juan Luca Sacchi interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Tiago Gabriel (Lecce). Pisa are awarded the free kick.
47' The ball falls to Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) on the edge of the box, but his shot goes well wide of the goal.
47' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
46' Substitution. Raul Albiol (Pisa) on for Arturo Calabresi.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Flag goes up against Henrik Meister (Pisa) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) leaps highest to meet the resulting corner and attempts to head home, but the effort goes harmlessly wide of the left post.
44' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
42' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) takes the corner with a short pass.
42' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Good work from Lecce as they win a corner.
39' Lecce take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

39' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Corner kick. Lecce will have an opportunity.
34' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
33' Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) receives a yellow card.
32' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) is caught offside!

31' Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the right post! What a huge opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
31' Lecce will take a corner kick.
30' PENALTY APPEAL by Lecce, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
28' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
27' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.

27' Corrie Ndaba (Lecce) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Lecce are awarded a corner kick.
25' Lecce hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

20' A pass travels right across the box to Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Adrian Semper denies him with a decent save.
19' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.

18' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
18' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
17' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
11' Medon Berisha (Lecce) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Mohamed Kaba comes onto the pitch to replace him.
9' The game is interrupted now, Medon Berisha (Lecce) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
7' Henrik Meister (Pisa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
6' Lecce have a corner.
6' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Lecce.
3' Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
1' The first half has started.
Pisa will kick-off.
Juan Luca Sacchi will referee today's match.
